exam_scheme.note: PGIMER Chandigarh recruits Nursing Officers and Store Keepers through an online Computer Based Test (CBT). The examination comprises 100 multiple-choice questions of 100 marks with a duration of 100 minutes (1 hour 40 minutes). Negative marking of 0.25 marks is deducted for each incorrect answer. The syllabus encompasses 75% domain nursing subject topics (Medical-Surgical, Paediatrics, Obstetric & Gynaecological Nursing, Community Health, Psychiatry, Pharmacology) and 25% General Awareness, Reasoning, English, and Quantitative Aptitude. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for General/EWS, 45% for SC/ST/OBC.

financial_package.note: Nursing Officers at PGIMER Chandigarh receive Central Government remuneration under Pay Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900; ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400) along with Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month), Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/month), and standard central allowances.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + HRA (₹8,980 for Chandigarh Class Y city) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo) + Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/mo) yielding Gross ~₹94,610; net in-hand is ~₹80,000–₹82,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and standard taxes.
official_perks: Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month as sanctioned by Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
Uniform Allowance of ₹1,800 per month (₹21,600 per annum)
